title: wg: protocol-06 §3 example paths inconsistent with §5
description: Erratum. §3 flows use POST /update/a.example/r/clubhouse (L584), /submit/... (L640; endpoint is submitMessage), /groupInfo/a.example/clubhouse (L818, drops /r/), with no scheme or percent-encoding, while §5.2 (L1068) says "with any necessary percent-encoding". mimid percent-encodes the whole URI (decision mimid-1wgh.5.18). Fix: show encoded full URIs and real endpoint names.
notes:
Editor's copy also has: L516 'POST /update/a.example/r/clubhousee' (extra e) and L582 'POST /update/a.example/clubhouse' (drops /r/).

Verified 2026-10-18 vs -06/-09/-04 (= main): CONFIRMED editorial paths; L584 is fine, bad ones L818, L824-831; also §3 POST /keyMaterial lacks {targetUser}.

Editorial part in PR https://github.com/ietf-wg-mimi/mimi-protocol/pull/164
